data.summary: Beispielwerke Versorgung GmbH sent the annual gas bill (Jahresabrechnung) for the supply address Am Mühlbach 2, covering 1 November 2025 to 31 October 2026. After deducting the advance payments already made, a back payment (Nachzahlung) of €169.24 is due, payable within 30 calendar days of the invoice date (27 November 2026).
data.explanation: This is your yearly gas usage statement. Based on your actual consumption and the fixed fee, minus the 12 monthly advance payments (Abschläge) you already made, you owe an additional €169.24. Pay this amount to the IBAN shown by the deadline the app displays (30 calendar days from the invoice date). The letter says partial payments can be arranged by agreement if you contact the provider. If you don't pay in time, late payment reminders or interest could follow, though none is mentioned here.

items.title: Pay the gas bill back payment (Nachzahlung)
items.action: Transfer €169.24 to the provider's IBAN, or contact them to arrange instalments.
